title: The dual of a perfect complex
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth, separated of finite type and of pure relative
dimension $d$, with orientation
$\gamma_f=\gamma_{f,\Lambda_Y}:\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^!\Lambda_Y$
of [sk-def-sf-orientation] (the smooth-purity orientation; the base $Y$
is arbitrary within the setting of [sk-def-sf-orientation]). Put
$\mathbb D_{X/Y}K=\RHom_X(K,Rf^!\Lambda_Y)$ and let
$K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ be perfect over $\Lambda_X$. Then the composite

$$
\theta_{f,K}:\ \mathbb D_{X/Y}K=\RHom_X(K,Rf^!\Lambda_Y)
\xrightarrow{\ \RHom_X(K,\gamma_f^{-1})\ }
\RHom_X\bigl(K,\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K^\vee(d)[2d],
$$

whose second arrow is the canonical twist isomorphism of
[sk-lem-sf-twist-interchange] with $m=d$, $n=2d$, is an isomorphism, natural
in $K$; so $\mathbb D_{X/Y}$ restricts to an anti-equivalence on the perfect
objects, and under $\theta_f$ the biduality $K\to\mathbb D_{X/Y}\mathbb
D_{X/Y}K$ is the coefficient-dual biduality $K\to K^{\vee\vee}$, namely the transpose of coefficient evaluation under the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction of [sk-def-sf-operations](i). The absolute case is $Y=\Spec k$,
$f=a_X$: then $\mathbb D_{X/Y}=\mathbb D_X$, $Rf^!\Lambda=\omega_X$, and we
write $\gamma_X=\gamma_{a_X}$ and $\theta_K=\theta_{a_X,K}:\mathbb
D_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}K^\vee(d)[2d]$.

proof.text: Use lem-sf-orientation-perfect-lines to place the actual orientation lines and exceptional images in the four finite-Tor domains and make each source line invertible. Use the coefficient evaluation laws and canonical twist interchange to construct theta, identify its inverse with sfPerfectThetaInverse, and prove naturality on the dualizable full subcategory.

Apply the generic evaluation-law core of lem-sf-oriented-double-hom-cancellation to the two inverse-line contractions. Its canonical inverse q agrees by adjunction target naturality with sfPerfectLineCancellation. Factor the double-Hom map through theta and gamma to obtain exactly the specified relative-bidual-to-coefficient-bidual equation. Coefficient biduality is invertible by lem-sf-perfect-dual-pair-and-tate-stability, hence relative biduality is invertible. The same lemma supplies coefficient dual closure; tensoring with the invertible line and theta gives relative dual closure.

Lift actual relative internal Hom to the full subcategory of dualizable objects. Naturality of its invertible evaluation-transpose biduality gives an isomorphism id to the square of this contravariant functor. Its opposite inverse gives the other isomorphism. Equivalence.mk supplies the anti-equivalence with precisely this lifted functor. Apply the identical assembly to all four coefficient stages. Structure-morphism specialization is literal substitution.

All six original arguments are retained verbatim in the report with their new owners.
